nodes.description: Public total token supply variable declared in EIP20Interface, written by the constructor.
Mapping address => uint256 holding token balances; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping owner => spender => uint256 allowance; mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Constant 2**256 - 1 used as the infinite-allowance sentinel in transferFrom.
Optional public token name, set once in the constructor.
Optional public decimals value, set once in the constructor.
Optional public token symbol, set once in the constructor.
Constructor: mints the entire initial amount to msg.sender and sets name, decimals and symbol.
Public transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) that debits msg.sender and credits _to with no reentrancy guard.
Public transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) that spends allowance and moves balances.
Public view returning balances[_owner].
Public approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) that overwrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender] (classic approve race).
Public view returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and event emitter.
balances[msg.sender] -= _value in transfer; unchecked 0.4.21 subtraction only guarded by a require.
balances[_to] += _value in transfer; unchecked addition that can overflow uint256.
balances[_to] += _value in transferFrom; unchecked addition, recipient credited before sender debited.
balances[_from] -= _value in transferFrom; unchecked subtraction only guarded by a require.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom; unchecked allowance decrement skipped when allowance is MAX_UINT256.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value in approve; unrestricted overwrite enabling the approve front-running race.
balances[msg.sender] = _initialAmount in the constructor; privileged mint to deployer.
Constructor parameter _initialAmount, the total supply minted to the deployer.
Constructor parameter _tokenName written into name.
Constructor parameter _decimalUnits written into decimals.
Constructor parameter _tokenSymbol written into symbol.
transfer parameter _to, the credited recipient address.
transfer parameter _value, the caller-controlled amount debited and credited.
transferFrom parameter _from, the debited address and allowance owner.
transferFrom parameter _to, the credited recipient address.
transferFrom parameter _value, the caller-controlled amount moved and deducted from allowance.
balanceOf parameter _owner, address whose balance is queried.
approve parameter _spender, address granted the allowance.
approve parameter _value, the new allowance amount written verbatim.
allowance parameter _owner, allowance owner queried.
allowance parameter _spender, allowance spender queried.
Local uint256 allowance in transferFrom, copied from allowed[_from][msg.sender] and compared against MAX_UINT256.

edges.reason: Constructor body executes the privileged balance assignment for the deployer.
_initialAmount is written into balances[msg.sender], defining the deployer's minted balance.
_initialAmount is assigned to totalSupply in the constructor.
_tokenName is written into the name state variable.
_decimalUnits is written into the decimals state variable.
_tokenSymbol is written into the symbol state variable.
msg.sender is the address that receives the entire initial supply, a privileged deployment-time grant.
Constructor sets totalSupply from _initialAmount.
transfer executes the sender balance decrement.
transfer executes the recipient balance increment.
Caller-controlled _value is subtracted from balances[msg.sender]; Solidity 0.4.21 has no built-in underflow check.
Caller-controlled _value is added to balances[_to] with no overflow check, so the sum can wrap.
_to selects the storage slot that is credited.
msg.sender determines whose balance is debited, coupling caller identity to the arithmetic state write.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom executes the recipient balance increment before debiting the sender.
transferFrom executes the sender balance decrement.
transferFrom conditionally executes the allowance decrement when allowance < MAX_UINT256.
_to selects the credited slot for an unchecked addition of _value.
_from selects the debited slot for an unchecked subtraction of _value.
Caller-controlled _value is subtracted from balances[_from] with only a require guard.
Caller-controlled _value is subtracted from allowed[_from][msg.sender] without a safe-math check.
The cached local allowance is the operand decremented in the allowance update.

_spender receives an arbitrary allowance from the caller, enabling the approve front-running race.
_value is written verbatim as the new allowance without requiring a zero reset.
msg.sender is the allowance owner whose funds the spender may later move.
_owner is used to look up balances in balanceOf.
_owner is used to look up allowed in allowance.
_spender is used to look up allowed in allowance.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowed mapping.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
transferFrom branches on the local allowance compared against MAX_UINT256.
